steps: Open claude.ai/code/routines and start a New scheduled task.

steps: Open claude.ai/code/routines and start a New scheduled task. This is the first of two.
Name: type Board START Opus.
Prompt box: tap Copy this text (below the steps) and paste it into the big prompt box.
Model picker at the bottom right of the prompt box: choose Opus 5.5 and set the effort to Medium.

Trigger row: it should show API (not Schedule) with the words Token will be generated when you save. That is correct and nothing is missing. If the little menu with Schedule and GitHub event is open, tap an empty part of the screen to close it. Do not add either of those.

Tap Create. A box called Token generated may pop up. If it does, copy the token into Notes right away (it is shown only once) and label it OPUS MEDIUM TOKEN. Then open the task's menu next to its name, choose Edit, and in the Trigger row copy the Fire URL (a long address starting with https://api.anthropic.com) into Notes, labelled OPUS MEDIUM URL. If you missed the token, tap Regenerate there to get a new one.
Start a second New scheduled task. Name: type Board START Sonnet High. Prompt box: paste the same text again (Copy this text, below the steps).

Model picker for the second task: choose Sonnet 5.5 and set the effort to High (it starts on Medium, change it). Trigger row: API again, nothing else. Tap Create, then copy its token and Fire URL into Notes the same way, labelled SONNET HIGH TOKEN and SONNET HIGH URL.

On github.com open the repo, then Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > New repository secret. Add four secrets, one at a time: CLAUDE_TASK_OPUS_MEDIUM_URL and CLAUDE_TASK_OPUS_MEDIUM_TOKEN (from the first task), then CLAUDE_TASK_SONNET_HIGH_URL and CLAUDE_TASK_SONNET_HIGH_TOKEN (from the second).
